name: Risograph Print SDXL (as downloaded - INERT)
means: Nothing, in this ComfyUI build. Kept only as the provenance and the control for risograph-print-sdxl, which is this file with its tensor keys renamed. Do not put this one in a workflow.
verdict: MEASURED INERT, TWICE OVER. A four-column ladder at 0 / 0.65 / 0.85 / 1.0 on animagine, one seed, trigger present in every cell, came back four pixel-identical images (samples/model_intake/ladder_animagine-xl-40_risograph-print_risograph.jpg). The log says why: 3360 `lora key not loaded` lines across the three non-zero cells, i.e. 1120 of 1120 keys ignored, three times. ComfyUI loaded not one tensor. This is the silent no-op lora_scan.py was written to warn about, caught in the act.
note: THE GATE THIS WAS BOUGHT AGAINST. studio/_tools/model_intake.py rendered eleven style probes on four installed engines before anything was downloaded (samples/model_intake/base_animagine-xl-4.jpg, base_Illustrious-XL-v2.jpg, cross_flux2.jpg, cross_qwen.jpg). Ten of the eleven were already covered: animagine renders pixel art, coloring-book lineart and a genuine watercolour from tags; Illustrious renders real painterly oil that animagine cannot; FLUX.2 renders claymation, woodcut, comic halftone, low-poly PS1, watercolour and photography outright; Qwen renders photography and nothing else - every probe came back a photograph, exactly as the project's standing rule says. ROOT CAUSE, and it is NOT that the LoRA is bad. The file is a diffusers ATTENTION-PROCESSOR LoRA: 1120 tensors, attn1/attn2 to_q/to_k/to_v/to_out.0 only, keys shaped `unet.<block>.attnN.to_k.lora.down.weight`. The `.lora.down.weight` suffix is accepted (comfy/weight_adapter/lora.py:163,183). The BASE key is not: ComfyUI's SDXL map builds `unet.<block>.attnN.processor.to_k` and turns `.to_out.0` into `.to_out` (comfy/lora.py:208-213). One missing `.processor.` made the whole file dead. `python3 studio/_tools/model_intake.py keyfix risograph-print.safetensors` does the rename and writes risograph-print_cfy.safetensors - see that card. | KEPT ON DISK DELIBERATELY. It is 93 MB, it is the sha256 provenance for the working derivative, and a card pointing at a deleted file is a scan failure. | PROVENANCE. url https://huggingface.co/strkyyy/risograph-print/resolve/main/risograph-print.safetensors | licence openrail++ | sha256 f5084f744817cdcc8fa3fb7f4edc8999db71a4250f786f54c627673ae5eddc90 | 93065304 bytes | downloaded 2026-08-05 | upstream base_model stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0.
example_note: Left cell is the control at strength 0 and the trigger phrase is in that cell too, so strength is the only variable. A LoRA is a delta on the base weights - a single with-the-LoRA image proves nothing, the OFF cell is the evidence.
